# NeuralVariabilityInjection

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method of introducing stochastic variability into artificial neural network activations or weights to mimic biological neural noise. Enhances network robustness in neuromorphic systems, potentially improving resilience to hardware faults and environmental perturbations.
